description:
## Goal

Build the phone-agent scenario: a phone- and browser-accessible agent assistant that bridges a single voice call to per-turn agent-manager runs, with a routine registry for recurring or ad-hoc calls.

## P0 Features

### Call lifecycle
- Inbound: answer Twilio call, resolve routine from caller-ID, attach voice-session
- Outbound: place call via resource-twilio (specifying routine + target number), attach on answer
- Browser: open UI, pick routine + browser-voice transport, attach
- Disconnect/reconnect with context resume within a configurable window

### Transport selector
- UI surface: Start call, pick browser or phone (with number)
- Phone mode places outbound via resource-twilio
- Browser mode uses audio-tools browser-voice transport
- One active transport per call; if a phone call is active and browser opens, browser is observer-only (muted mic)

### Agent-manager runner integration
- Per user utterance: construct an agent-manager run with rolling conversation history + routine profile/skill
- Subscribe to run event stream (assistant deltas) and push to TTS as sentences complete
- Track in-flight run per call so barge-in can cancel it

### Per-call state
- Transcript, turn history (used for next-turn context packing), call outcomes (decisions approved, backlog items created, knowledge entries saved)
- Persist per call so transcripts survive disconnect

### Barge-in
- VAD signal from voice-session cancels in-flight TTS audio
- Best-effort cancel on the in-flight agent-manager run (run-stop)
- New user utterance starts a new turn

### Routine registry
- Routine schema per research/phone-agent-routine-and-runner-model
- Local routine store (per duplicate-before-extract — do not share with other scenarios yet)
- Scheduled triggers via the existing schedule surface (do NOT implement cron locally)

### UI
- Active call view: live transcript, waveform (browser-voice mode), call controls, transport indicator
- Routine picker
- Call history with replayable transcripts
- Caller-ID allow-list management

### Billing/cost emission
- Per-call events: STT seconds, TTS seconds, agent tokens, Twilio minutes (when applicable)
- Emit to whatever billing/cost surface continuous-audio-platform settles on

## Out of scope (v1)

- Observer-mode participation via typing during a phone call
- Simultaneous phone + browser audio on the same call
- Multi-user ACL on call transcripts (single-user trust model)
- Generic browser voice agent for non-phone use cases

## Architecture

- Go API server (standard scenario pattern)
- React UI
- Consumes audio-tools voice-session + browser-voice transport (and twilio-voice when available)
- Drives agent-manager via its run API
- Consumes resource-twilio for telephony
